name: Legacy of Ozem
text:
**Legacy of Ozem**

Your purity is so great that the blades and bows of long-forgotten
 heroes sing to you as if they had been made for
 your righteous hands.

**Prerequisites**: Base attack bonus +5, good alignment.

**Benefit**: When using good-aligned weapons, including
 those under the effects of a bless weapon spell, you gain a
 +1 sacred bonus on damage rolls.
